mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening labor demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings for industrial firms and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month INDPRO decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% combined with a decline in average hourly earnings (HOUST) signals weakening labor demand and wage pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% and HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months
regime_hint: labor market cooling with wage pressure
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE > 4.0% and 3-month HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and housing market activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening manufacturing activity and consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of 3-month INDPRO and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05).
